subject: Publish workflow audit: likely account-level Actions gating, not YAML
body: I audited .github/workflows/publish-to-motor-city-math.yml against docs/publish-runbook.md. Workflow YAML is structurally valid; runbook already records 0-job failure tied to private-repo Actions gating on marcusash_microsoft billing/account settings. Recommended path remains scripts/publish.cjs until account-level Actions is enabled. If you want, I can still harden workflow with explicit permissions and clearer fail messages once runs are allowed.
